name: Berlin Weather by Date

steps.expression: const d = input.input.date; return (d !== undefined && d !== null) ? d : new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);

const daily = input.scope.fetch_forecast.data.daily; return { city: 'Berlin, Germany', date: daily.time[0], temperature_max_c: daily.temperature_2m_max[0], temperature_min_c: daily.temperature_2m_min[0], precipitation_mm: daily.precipitation_sum[0], weathercode: daily.weathercode[0], windspeed_max_kmh: daily.windspeed_10m_max[0] };

description: Fetch weather forecast for Berlin, Germany for tomorrow (automatically calculated)

date.description: Datum im Format YYYY-MM-DD. Falls nicht angegeben, wird morgen verwendet.
